faqs.q: Do I pay VisionX for AI?
faqs.a: No. You connect your own Claude or Gemini API key in the app's Settings, and your AI provider bills you directly for usage. VisionX does not sell AI credits.

faqs.q: Can we send from our own domain?
faqs.a: Yes. Use a customer-owned sending domain and the SPF/DKIM/DMARC verification wizard to authenticate sending.

faqs.q: What happens if a sending provider has an outage?
faqs.a: A backup sending provider supports continuity when the primary provider has an outage; this is not a guarantee of uninterrupted delivery.

OmniReach v2.48 covers email, WhatsApp, SMS, RCS and push. Choose channels that fit your consent and delivery requirements; WhatsApp requires approved templates and valid phone details. Connected services require customer setup.
Contact and sending limits depend on the usage-based plan. We confirm the limits and expected volumes in your proposal.
Consent tracking, unsubscribe management and suppression lists support consent-based outreach. Your organization remains responsible for its lawful basis and applicable obligations.

faqs.q: Can we migrate from other tools?
faqs.a: Yes. Import contacts by CSV and map custom fields, tags, consent and suppression records. Confirm migration scope before switching senders.

faqs.q: Is OmniReach ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certified?
faqs.a: The trust register supports ISO 27001 / SOC 2 readiness controls. Readiness is not certification; no certification is claimed.

problems.outcome: Authenticated custom domains and managed sending.
